cs-basics-1.title: Computer Science Basics — Set 1
cs-basics-1.description: Foundational CS concepts: algorithms, binary, variables, loops, conditionals, hardware and software, and key figures in computing history.

cs-basics-2.title: Computer Science Basics — Set 2
cs-basics-2.description: More foundational CS: operating systems, RAM vs. storage, arrays, programming languages, pixels, search engines, cloud computing, and computing history.

cybersecurity.title: Cybersecurity
cybersecurity.description: Phishing, malware, viruses, firewalls, two-factor authentication, social engineering, ransomware, VPNs, data breaches, and digital footprints.

roblox-safety.title: Roblox Online Safety
roblox-safety.description: Online safety while gaming: strangers, personal information, chat risks, Robux scams, cyberbullying, reporting tools, warning signs, and trusted adults.

pentesting.title: White Hat Hacking & Penetration Testing
pentesting.description: Ethical hacking, pen test phases, scope and authorization, red vs. blue team, bug bounties, CTF competitions, certifications, and cybersecurity careers.

data-structures.title: Data Structures & Variables
data-structures.description: Data types, integers and floats, strings, concatenation, indexing, booleans, lists, dictionaries, tuples, nested lists, and type conversion.

loops.title: Loops
loops.description: For loops, while loops, counters, infinite loops, nested loops, break and continue, off-by-one errors, the accumulator pattern, and loop efficiency.
